modalLead: A calmer config page: far fewer competing borders, so sections and topics stand out through spacing and headings instead of stacked frames.

items.text: Fewer borders, clearer sections — the config page had many nested frames stacking up at once (save bar, tab bar, group labels, intro, quick-links sidebar, cards, per-row lines). Borders are now reserved for the outer tab surface and real dividers; everything inside is separated by spacing and headings instead, so it reads calmer while sections and topics stay easy to tell apart.
Cleaner quick-links list — the section sidebar dropped its frame and per-item lines; it's now a simple list with a clear highlight on the active section.
